name: api-connector
why: The API connector keeps its connections' credentials (the same `api` connection, one account per slug), its role scopes and pending approvals (the same tool names). Its adapters and their kept versions move into the platform's tables (kernel.api_adapters, kernel.api_adapter_versions), keyed by the app and its connection (connections/api/); the copy runs at every boot and leaves the app's tables as they are.
